name: 4C-B
summary: 4C-B, also known as 4C-DOB or DOB-B, as well as 4-bromo-2,5-dimethoxy-α-ethylphenethylamine, is a lesser-known psychedelic drug of the phenethylamine, phenylisobutylamine, and 4C families related to 2C-B (the 2C analogue) and DOB (the DOx analogue).

pharmacology.text: The drug is a reasonably potent serotonin 5-HT2A receptor partial agonist with a Ki of 7.6 nM, but has relatively low efficacy (15% relative to 5-HT).
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the psychedelic phenethylamines, can cause nausea, dilated pupils, a faster heartbeat, raised blood pressure, muscle tension, anxiety, confusion and frightening experiences. In people at risk, they can trigger lasting mental health problems such as psychosis.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同類的迷幻苯乙胺類藥物，可能引起噁心、瞳孔放大、心跳加快、血壓升高、肌肉緊繃、焦慮、意識混亂與驚恐的經驗。對本身有風險的人，可能誘發精神病等持久的心理健康問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同类的迷幻苯乙胺类药物，可能引起恶心、瞳孔放大、心跳加快、血压升高、肌肉紧绷、焦虑、意识混乱与惊恐的经验。对本身有风险的人，可能诱发精神病等持久的心理健康问题。

fact.en: The 4C name counts carbons: where 2C-B has a two-carbon chain between ring and nitrogen and DOB adds a methyl branch, 4C-B adds a two-carbon ethyl branch instead.
fact.zh: 「4C」這個名稱是在數碳原子：2C-B在環與氮之間有兩個碳的鏈，DOB在上面多了一個甲基分支，而4C-B則改加一個兩碳的乙基分支。
fact.zhHans: 「4C」这个名称是在数碳原子：2C-B在环与氮之间有两个碳的链，DOB在上面多了一个甲基分支，而4C-B则改加一个两碳的乙基分支。
